statusLine.command: input=$(cat); ctx=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); cache_file="$HOME/.claude/.statusline_account_cache"; now=$(date +%s); age=999999; if [ -f "$cache_file" ]; then mtime=$(stat -f %m "$cache_file" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$cache_file" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$mtime" ] && age=$((now - mtime)); fi; if [ "$age" -gt 300 ]; then acct=$(claude auth status 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.email // empty'); [ -n "$acct" ] && printf '%s' "$acct" > "$cache_file"; fi; acct=$(cat "$cache_file" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$acct" ] && acct="unknown"; ctx_str="Ctx: --"; [ -n "$ctx" ] && ctx_str=$(printf 'Ctx: %.0f%%' "$ctx"); five_str="5h: --"; [ -n "$five" ] && five_str=$(printf '5h: %.0f%%' "$five"); printf '%s | %s | %s' "$acct" "$ctx_str" "$five_str"
